schema: camera hyper-parameters for SPAM pmfs, from ioncam dark frames, v1 (2026-10-17)

source.frames: dark (shutter closed), internal trigger, 3e6 samples per setting

conventions.B: centre of the read-noise Gaussian; integer bins [k-1/2, k+1/2]
conventions.sigma: Gaussian read noise per read, ADU, frame-to-frame common mode included
conventions.g: ADU per electron entering the EM register
conventions.c_s: serial (partial-gain) CIC events per super-pixel per frame; output exponential with log-uniform mean between g/200 and g
conventions.lam_cic: full-gain events per super-pixel per frame (parallel CIC + dark current): the camera part of lam_bg

g_adu_per_e.use: per session: fit with the prior, or measure in the same session

B_adu.use: fit per ROI and data set (column pattern; moves ~1 ADU with the shift speed)

1.7.basis: 1x1 fit scaled by the 3.3 us binning ratios; alt = scaled by the total event rate

0.9.basis: 1x1 fit scaled by the 3.3 us binning ratios; alt = scaled by the total event rate

0.5.basis: 1x1 fit scaled by the 3.3 us binning ratios; alt = scaled by the total event rate

0.3.basis: 1x1 fit scaled by the 3.3 us binning ratios; alt = scaled by the total event rate

aqroi_column_factor.applies_to: x 347-355 (13 Oct AQROI) against the measured region; multiply lam_cic and c_s

ion_used_for_predictions: run 106415: lam_B 12.83 e-, a_bd 0.2311, a_db 0.01478, 1.1 ms beam, no light
